item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 85 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 85 #NLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 05:00 AM 11 September 2026

Light to Moderate to at times Heavy rains are expected over #Aurora, #Pangasinan(Agno, Aguilar, CityOfAlaminos, Alcala, Anda, Bani, Basista, Bautista, Bayambang, Binmaley, Bolinao, Bugallon, Burgos, Calasiao, DagupanCity, Dasol, Infanta, Labrador, Lingayen, Mabini, Malasiqui, Mangatarem, SanCarlosCity, SantaBarbara, SantoTomas, Sual, Urbiztondo, SanJacinto, Mangaldan, SanFabian, Manaoag, Mapandan, CityOfUrdaneta, Villasis, Rosales), #Isabela(Divilacan, Echague, Jones, SanAgustin, SanMariano, SanGuillermo, Maconacon, SanPablo, Cabagan, Tumauini, IlaganCity), #Cagayan(Calayan, Baggao, Peñablanca), #Batanes(Basco, Ivana, Mahatao, Sabtang, Uyugan), #Quirino(Maddela, Nagtipunan) and #NuevaVizcaya(AlfonsoCastaneda) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Isabela(Dinapigue, Palanan) and #Batanes(Itbayat) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
